layout_dets.text: Abstract

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Accurate segmentation of topological tubular structures,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: such as blood vessels and roads, is crucial in various

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: fields, ensuring accuracy and efficiency in downstream

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tasks. However, many factors complicate the task, includ-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing thin local structures and variable global morphologies.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In this work, we note the specificity of tubular structures

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and use this knowledge to guide our DSCNet to simultane-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ously enhance perception in three stages: feature extrac-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion, feature fusion, and loss constraint. First, we propose

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: a dynamic snake convolution to accurately capture the fea-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tures of tubular structures by adaptively focusing on slen-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: der and tortuous local structures. Subsequently, we pro-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pose a multi-view feature fusion strategy to complement the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: attention to features from multiple perspectives during fea-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ture fusion, ensuring the retention of important information

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: from different global morphologies. Finally, a continuity

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: constraint loss function, based on persistent homology, is

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: proposed to constrain the topological continuity of the seg-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mentation better. Experiments on 2D and 3D datasets show

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: that our DSCNet provides better accuracy and continuity

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: on the tubular structure segmentation task compared with

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: several methods. Our codes are publicly available.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 1. Introduction

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The accurate segmentation of topological tubular struc-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tures is paramount in various fields to ensure the precision

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and efficiency of downstream tasks. In clinical applications,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: a well-delineated blood vessel is a crucial prerequisite for

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: computational hemodynamics, and it assists radiologists in

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Figure 1. Challenges. The above figure shows a 3D heart vascular

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: dataset and a 2D remote road dataset. Both datasets aim to extract

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tubular structures, but this task faces challenges due to fragile local

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: structures and complex global morphology. Motivation. The stan-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: dard convolutional kernel is intended to extract local features. On

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: this basis, deformable convolutional kernels have been designed

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to enrich their application and adapt to geometric deformations of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: different targets. However, due to the aforementioned challenges,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: it is difficult to focus efficiently on the thin tubular structures.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: locating and diagnosing lesions [13, 16]. In remote sensing

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: applications, complete road segmentation provides a solid

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: foundation for route planning. Regardless of the field, these

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: structures share common features of being thin and tortu-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ous, which make them challenging to capture due to their

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: small proportion in images. Therefore, there is an urgent

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: need to enhance the perception of thin tubular structures.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: However, it remains challenging due to the following dif-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ficulties: (1) Thin and fragile local structure. As shown

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: in Figure 1, thin structures account for only a small pro-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: portion of the overall image with limited pixel composi-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion. Moreover, these structures are susceptible to inter-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ference from complex backgrounds, rendering it difficult to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: precisely discriminate subtle target variations by the model.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Consequently, the model may struggle to differentiate these

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: structures, resulting in the fracture of the segmentation.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: (2) Complex and variable global morphology. Figure 1

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: shows the complex and variable morphology of thin tubu-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: lar structures, even within the same image. Morphologi-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cal variations are observed in targets located in different re-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: gions, depending on the number of branches, the location

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of bifurcations, and the path length. The model may tend

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to overfit features that have already been seen, resulting in

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: weak generalization when the data exhibits unprecedented

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: morphological structures.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Recently, many studies have proposed incorporating do-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: main knowledge (e.g. geometric topology and tree struc-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ture) to guide the model better to perceive the distinctive

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: features of the tubular structures, thus focusing on improv-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing the accuracy of local segmentation and maintaining the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: continuity of global morphology. Existing methods can

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: be broadly classified into three categories: (1) Network-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: based methods [7, 12, 31, 28, 14, 8] design specific net-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: work architectures according to the characteristics of the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tubular structures that guide the model to focus on critical

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: features. However, given the small proportion of tubular

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: structures, the network may inevitably lose the perception

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of the corresponding structures. (2) Feature-based methods

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: [21, 33, 15, 35, 20] enhance the comprehension of the par-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ticular geometric and topological features of tubular struc-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tures by supplementing the model with additional feature

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: representations. However, some redundant feature repre-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sentations exacerbate the computational burden while not

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: providing a positive influence on the model. (3) Loss-based

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: methods [24, 29, 1, 30] incorporate measurement meth-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ods to supplement constraints during the training process,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: typically through loss functions. These methods reinforce

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the stringent constraints on segmentation. Building on this

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: foundation, structured losses combined with continuity con-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: straints from the topological perspective will potentially fur-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ther improve the accuracy of the tubular segmentation.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: To tackle the above obstacles, we propose a novel frame-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: work, DSCNet, involving a tubular-aware convolution ker-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: nel, multi-view feature fusion strategy, and topological con-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tinuity constraint loss function. (1) To address the chal-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: lenge of the small proportion of thin and fragile local struc-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tures that are difficult for the model to focus on, we propose

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Dynamic Serpentine Convolution (DSConv) to enhance the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: perception of the geometric structure by adaptively focus-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing on the thin and curved local features of tubular struc-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tures. Unlike deformable convolution [6], which leaves

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the network completely free to learn geometrical changes,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: thus causing perceptual regions to wander, especially on

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: thin tubular structures, our DSConv considers the snake-like

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: morphology of tubular structures and supplements the free

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: learning process with constraints that allow for targeted en-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: hancement of the perception of tubular structures. (2) To

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: address the challenge of complex and variable global mor-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: phology, we propose a multi-view feature fusion strategy.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In this method, we generate multiple morphological kernel

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: templates based on DSConv for viewing the structural fea-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tures of the target from various perspectives and achieve

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: efficient feature fusion by summarizing typical vital fea-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tures. (3) To address the problem that segmentation of tubu-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: lar structures is prone to fracture, we propose a Topologi-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cal Continuity Constrained Loss Function (TCLoss) based

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: on Persistent Homology (PH). PH[9, 19, 5] responds to the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: process of topological features from emergence to disap-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pearance. It obtains adequate topological information from

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: noisy high-dimensional data. The related Betti numbers are

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: one way of describing connectivity in the topological space.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Unlike [30, 10], our TCLoss combines PH with point set

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: similarity to pilot the network to focus on fracture regions

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: with anomalous pixel/voxel distributions, achieving conti-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: nuity constraints from a topological perspective.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: To summarize, our work proposes a novel framework

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of knowledge fusion addressing the difficulties of the thin

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tubular structures, and the specific contributions are three-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: fold. (1) We propose a dynamic snake convolution to adap-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tively focus on the slender and tortuous local features and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: realize the accurate tubular structures segmentation on both

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2D and 3D datasets. Our model is thoroughly verified us-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing both internal and external test data. (2) We propose a

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: multi-perspective feature fusion strategy to supplement the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: attention to the vital features from multiple perspectives. (3)

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: We propose a topological continuity constraint loss function

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: based on Persistent Homology, which better constrains the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: continuity of the segmentation.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2. Related Work

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2.1. Methods based on Network Design

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Various methods have been proposed to achieve better

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: performance by designing particular network architectures

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and modules according to the morphology of the tubular

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: structures. (1) Methods based on the convolutional kernel

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: design, represented by the famous dilated convolution [32]

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and deformable convolution [6], are proposed to deal with

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the inherent limited geometric transformation in CNNs,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: showing outstanding performance on sophisticated detec-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion and segmentation tasks. These methods [7, 34, 12, 31]

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: are also designed to dynamically perceive the geometric

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: features of the objects to adapt to the structure with change-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: able morphology. For example, DUNet proposed in [12]

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: integrates the deformable convolution into the U-shape ar-

layout_dets.label: inline_formula
layout_dets.latex: K _ { i \pm c } = ( x _ { i \pm c } , y _ { i \pm c } )

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: chitecture and adaptively adjusts the receptive field accord-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing to the vessels’ scales and shapes. (2) Methods based

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: on the network architecture design are proposed to learn the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: special geometric topological features of the tubular struc-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tures. PointScatter [28] is proposed to represent the tubular

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: structure with points set, which is an alternative to the seg-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mentation models for the tubular structure extraction task.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: [14] proposed a tree-structured convolutional gated recur-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: rent unit to model the coronary artery's topological struc-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tures explicitly. Different from the ideas mentioned above

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of allowing the model to learn the geometric changes com-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pletely freely, considering the limitation of the convergence

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: difficulty caused by excessive randomness and the possibil-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ity that the model will focus on the unexpected regions of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the target. Our work integrates the domain knowledge of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tubular structure morphology to stably enhance the percep-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion of the tubular structure in the feature extraction process.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2.2. Methods based on Features Fusion

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Methods based on features fusion [35, 15, 33, 21, 20]

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: strengthens the representation of the tubular structure by

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: supplementing additional feature information to the model.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Considering the topology and the sparsity of the tubular

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: structures, [35] proposed a cross-network multi-scale fea-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ture fusion method performed between two networks to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: support high-quality vessel segmentation effectively. In

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: [15], a global transformer and dual local attention network

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: via deep-shallow hierarchical feature fusion are investigated

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to simultaneously capture the global and local characteri-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: zations. [33] proposed to fuse the contextual anatomical

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: information and vascular topologies for accurate tubular

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: structure segmentation. In our work, we propose a multi-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: perspective feature fusion strategy to supplement the atten-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion to the vital features from multiple perspectives. In this

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: strategy, we generate numerous morphological kernel tem-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: plates based on our DSConv to observe the structural char-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: acteristics of the target from multiple perspectives and real-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ize the feature fusion by summarizing the essential standard

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: features, thus improving the performance of our model.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2.3. Methods based on Loss Function

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Methods based on loss function [24, 29, 1] introduce

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: measurement methods to supplement constraints in the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: training process. These methods strengthen the strong con-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: straints on the tubular structures segmentation. [24] in-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: troduced a similarity measurement termed centerline Dice,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: which is calculated on the intersection of the segmenta-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion masks and the skeleton. [29] proposed a geometry-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: aware tubular structure segmentation method, Deep Dis-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tance Transform (DDT), which combines intuitions from

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the classical distance transform for skeletonization and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tubular structure segmentation. These methods focus on

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the continuity of the tubular structure segmentation, but the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: skeleton's inaccuracy and offset will affect the constraints'

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: precision. [1] proposed a similarity index that captures the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: topological consistency of the predicted segmentation and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: designs a loss function based on the morphological closing

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: operator for tubular structure segmentation. In [30], topo-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: logical data analysis methods are incorporated with a geo-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: metric deep learning model for fine-grained segmentation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: for 3D objects. These methods will capture the features of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the topological objects. Drawing inspiration from this, our

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: work proposes a topological continuity constraint loss func-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion (TCLoss) that better constrains the continuity of the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: segmentation from a topological perspective. Our TCLoss

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: gradually introduces constraints based on Persistence Ho-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mology [27, 2] during the training process to guide the net-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: work to focus on the fracture regions and realize continuity.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 3. Methodology

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Our method is designed to deal simultaneously with 2D

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and 3D feature maps of thin tubular structures. For sim-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: plicity, our modules are described in 2D, and the detailed

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: extension to 3D is also provided in our open source.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 3.1. Dynamic Snake Convolution

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In this section, we discuss how to perform Dynamic

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Snake Convolution (DSConv) to extract the tubular struc-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ture's local features. Given the standard 2D convolution co-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ordinates as

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the central coordinate is

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: . A

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In this study, we focus on the special features of the tubu-

layout_dets.text: lar structures and use this knowledge to guide the model to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: enhance the perception simultaneously in three stages: fea-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: we propose a dynamic snake convolution to adaptively fo-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cus on the thin and tortuous structure, thus accurately cap-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: turing the features of tubular structures. Secondly, we in-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: troduce a multi-view feature fusion strategy to complement

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the focus on features from multiple angles during feature fu-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sion, ensuring the retention of important information from

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: different global morphology. Lastly, we propose a topolog-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ical continuity constraint loss to constrain the topological

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: continuity of the segmentation. Our method is verified on

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: both 2D and 3D datasets and the results show our method

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: provides better accuracy and continuity on the tubular struc-

layout_dets.text: ture segmentation task compared with several methods.
